description: This Java source file defines the main entry point for the RomRaider application, handling initialization, logging, and opening the ECU editor interface.

classes.name: ECUExec
classes.description: Main application class responsible for starting the RomRaider ECU editor, handling initialization, and processing command-line arguments.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point; initializes logging, system properties, look and feel, and opens the ECU editor, possibly loading a ROM file.

methods.name: showAlreadyRunningMessage
methods.description: Displays a message dialog indicating the application is already running.

methods.name: containsLoggerArg
methods.description: Checks if command line arguments contain logger-related flags.

methods.name: openRom
methods.description: Asynchronously opens a specified ROM file in the ECU editor.

methods.name: openEditor
methods.description: Initializes the ECU editor UI and loads a ROM file if specified in command-line arguments.
